header: Example reviews of paid plans and services
total_reviews: Examples from Studio, Agency and the services

reviews.author: Daniel R., agency lead (example)
reviews.title: Our first client site with the Launch Pack
reviews.review_text: We booked the €5,970 Launch Pack: Agency, Kickstart and a Brand Theme. Editor training was included, and the client's editors built pages on their own by launch day.

reviews.author: Priya N., product owner (example)
reviews.title: Studio answers usually come the next morning
reviews.review_text: Answers are due within 2 business days, and most arrive the next morning. The maintenance promise keeps our TYPO3 patch updates on schedule.

reviews.author: Marcus L., CTO (example)
reviews.title: Brand Theme done properly
reviews.review_text: We ordered a Brand Theme and got our brand as colour tokens, with dark mode and checked contrast. Four stars only because we should have ordered it at the start.

reviews.author: Sofia B., site owner (example)
reviews.title: Upgrade audit, then a fixed quote
reviews.review_text: The €690 audit ended with a fixed quote for our move to TYPO3 v14. We booked the upgrade, and the €690 was credited to it.
